short: Nose-pad mic plus vibration sensor (M05) and dual-input fusion (M06) are standard; noise is added to the mic only, so the robustness claim is untested in real noise (M12, behind).
position: The paper [@rekimoto2026nasovoce] changes the sensor site (M05) and the fusion model (M06); both are standard, since conducted sensors paired with an air microphone were in use by 2004, and their fusion for recognition and for whispered enhancement in noise predates it [@graciarena2004combination; @jou2004softwhisper; @tajiri2015nam]. The nose site is new to the ledger but untested against any other site. Every quantitative test adds noise to the microphone channel only, so the evaluation (M12) is behind the field, where 44 of 123 studies name noise physically present against 15 with digital noise and the closest works expose the conducted sensor to noise [@fukumoto2025whisphone].
